name: @omp-dev-team/token-diet
description: Token-reduction toolkit for OMP: ctx-wire + context-mode + CodeGraph + caveman + yagni, plus read/context dedup and an opt-in protect-masked context compressor.
comment: Ships the CodeGraph MCP server (enabled in .mcp.json), an always-on rule, a config.snippet.yml, four skills (codegraph, caveman, yagni, token-diet), and three context-transform extensions: read-dedup + context-dedup are lossless and on by default; context-compress is lossy and opt-in via TOKEN_DIET_CONTEXT_COMPRESS=safe|lite|full. install.sh mirrors extensions/ into ~/.omp/agent/extensions/token-diet (OMP does not load extensions from marketplace cache installs) and installs ctx-wire PATH shims. Pure logic lives in extensions/lib and is unit-tested by scripts/extensions.test.ts.
